# Me-Admin

> Me-Admin is a free, MIT-licensed full-stack admin framework based on Midway 3 (Node.js, native ESM) + Sequelize + PostgreSQL on the backend and Vue 3 + Vite + Element Plus + vxeTable on the frontend. Define a Sequelize entity, run `pnpm exec meadmin sync <entity>` and `pnpm exec meadmin crud <entity> --menu`, and a complete CRUD module (controller, service, API, frontend pages, menu permissions) is generated as plain readable source code. Built-in RBAC (menu/button/API), users, roles, dictionaries, file storage, and a plugin system. Suited for solo developers and small teams building admin systems, SaaS backends, and mini-program backends.

This file helps AI coding assistants use Me-Admin correctly. The links below point to Markdown sources that are safe to fetch.

## Key Facts

- Install: `pnpm create meadminjs@latest` (requires Node.js >= 22.14, pnpm 9/10/11/12)
- Start dev: `pnpm dev` → admin panel at http://127.0.0.1:7001/admin (admin / meAdmin#202507!P)
- CLI is invoked via `pnpm exec meadmin <command>` — NOT `pnpm meadmin`
- Main commands: `sync <entity>` (sync DB schema), `crud <entity> --menu` (generate full module), `addon <file>` (install plugin), `compress` (deploy archive), `update` (upgrade framework)
- CLI does NOT auto-load `.env.local`; pass `-m local` when connecting to the local/dev database
- The project is native ESM ("type": "module", tsconfig module: NodeNext)
- Code generation is deterministic and idempotent; menu creation uses find-or-create, safe to re-run
